content.hi:
Quick Revision - All Concepts
Chapter ke sabse important concepts aur formulas:
• Standard Form: ax² + bx + c = 0, where a ≠ 0
• Factorization: a×c = product, b = sum → middle term split karo
• Completing the Square: (x + b/2a)² = (b²-4ac)/4a²
• Quadratic Formula: x = [-b ± √(b²-4ac)] / 2a
• Discriminant: D = b² - 4ac → D>0 (distinct), D=0 (equal), D<0 (no real)

💡 Yeh formulas aur concepts har exam mein aate hain - zaroor yaad rakho!

problem.hi: The altitude of a right triangle is 7 cm less than its base. If the hypotenuse is 13 cm, find the base.
problem.en: The altitude of a right triangle is 7 cm less than its base. If the hypotenuse is 13 cm, find the base.

steps.hi: Let base = x, altitude = x-7. x²+(x-7)²=169 → x²+x²-14x+49=169 → 2x²-14x-120=0 → x²-7x-60=0 → (x-12)(x+5)=0 → x=12. Base=12cm, altitude=5cm. Verify: 12²+5²=144+25=169=13² ✓
steps.en: Let base = x, altitude = x-7. x²+(x-7)²=169 → x²+x²-14x+49=169 → 2x²-14x-120=0 → x²-7x-60=0 → (x-12)(x+5)=0 → x=12. Base=12cm, altitude=5cm. Verify: 12²+5²=144+25=169=13² ✓
